name: OATutor study
description: Published participant summaries comparing human-authored and pre-generated ChatGPT hints; these are assigned conditions, not observed help events or live tutoring chats.

mapping.identifier_handling: Known subject identifiers are HMAC pseudonymized; selected source fields and text are retained. This is not a general anonymizer.

source.citation: Pardos, Zachary; Bhandari, Shreya (2023). ChatGPT-generated help produces learning gains equivalent to human tutors on mathematics skills. figshare. Dataset. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.23935269.v1
source.selectionNote: Exact source header and first 12 data records, preserving original bytes and CRLF newlines. No values, columns or records added or altered.
limitations: These are participant-level study summaries, not a product export or a hint/clickstream log.
condition is the assigned help condition, not proof that a participant opened or received a particular hint.
The participant table supplies no individual inquiry, hint text, event sequence or event timestamps.
The no-hint control still received correctness feedback and could request a bottom-out answer; assignment is not proof of no assistance.
The raw Human tutor condition means human tutor-authored hints, and ChatGPT means pre-generated ChatGPT solution hints. These are not recordings of live human or AI tutoring conversations.
preTest, postTest, sessionTime, totalUniqueSteps and learningGain remain original columns and values. No new effect size, pooled score or causal analysis is calculated.
anonUserID is a publisher anonymous participant identifier. Learnlog output replaces the known subject identifier with a scoped HMAC pseudonym. The original public sample remains unchanged.
